notes: Lets users independently choose whether Agent completions, requests for attention, and subagent activity should send notifications.
Shows waiting-for-input Agent updates as a distinct attention state in the activity feed and device notifications.
Turns the browser H5 page into a single PWA launcher after installation, so the browser surface no longer receives Agent notifications.
Keeps PWA notification permission checks in a loading state until the asynchronous browser result settles.
Retries desktop release metadata checks every seven hours so the version update dot stays current while DingDong is running.
Keeps Intel macOS and Windows packages marked as beta.
